method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories using federation history, participation/access scale, competition structure and development/support evidence with strict temporal gating.
evidence_rules: Mixed-sex federation/member facts describe the environment and are never relabelled as male-only participation.
Modern programme and membership facts are not backcast before their observation years.
Competition quality is grounded in competition structures/pathways where available, not directly copied from one player's peak.
Missing facts are represented by lower-confidence authored estimates, not zeros.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored values.
